title: PSIT OAS Launcher Engineering & Audit Tracker
description: Notion tracking database export for PSIT OAS Launcher (Modded)

records.title: Whole Screen Capture (Low Accuracy & Hallucinations)
records.root_cause: OCR snapped `(0, 0, screen.Width, screen.Height)`. Included candidate name, time countdown, palette grid (1..30), legend, and bottom buttons. Mixed numbers into question text.
records.solution: Implemented `Get-QuestionCaptureArea` targeting only the question/options quadrant (top 8.5%–88.5%, left 1.5%–75%). Added `Clean-OCRQuestionText` to strip noise.

records.title: AI Wrong Answers & Truncated Explanations
records.root_cause: Groq model was set to non-existent `'qwen/qwen3.8-27b'`. OpenRouter token limit was only 250, cutting off reasoning models before outputting `Ans: X`.
records.solution: Updated Groq model to `'llama-3.3-70b-versatile'` (with instant fallback). Increased token limit to 450, enforced bottom-up parsing for final answer line.

records.title: Button Fails on 2nd / 3rd Rapid Click
records.root_cause: 1) Mouse drag threshold was 3px; natural double-click twitch set `suppressClick = true`. 2) `$script:ocrBusy` blocked subsequent clicks while background timers ran.
records.solution: 1) Raised drag threshold to 10px. 2) Made click handler cancel/reset pending timers and immediately restart on new question.

records.title: Clicking Answer Text Fails to Hide It
records.root_cause: WinForms `TransparencyKey = Color.White` treated all white pixels as click-through transparent. Only 1px font stroke registered clicks.
records.solution: Replaced click-through white box with sleek dark HUD badge (`FromArgb(24, 26, 36)`). Every pixel on card + dedicated `×` dismiss button captures clicks.

records.title: Text Selection Broken on Test
records.root_cause: In `OASUnlocker.dll`, capturing `selectstart` listener executed `e.stopImmediatePropagation()`, aborting browser selection engine.
records.solution: Patched `OASUnlocker.dll` `#US` payload to neutralize `preventDefault` without stopping event propagation. Updated `test_page.html` selection CSS & event guards.

records.title: REA Setup (`morluto/rea`)
records.root_cause: Initialized and registered REA agents integration for inspecting .NET assemblies and native binaries.
records.solution: Ran `npx -y rea-agents setup --yes --all-detected`. Verified metadata extraction on `PSITOAS.exe` and `OASUnlocker.dll`.

records.title: Linux Native Support & Compiled Binary
records.root_cause: Linux systems lack native Win32 PowerShell / WinForms / Windows OCR.
records.solution: Created native Python/Tkinter engine (`launch_linux.py`) with `libtesseract` OCR, and compiled native 64-bit ELF executable binary (`Launch`).

records.title: Targeted High-Quality Snip & AI Solver on Screenshot
records.root_cause: Screenshot button previously captured full screen to clipboard only.
records.solution: Blue Dot now snips targeted question quadrant in uncompressed 32bpp, copies to clipboard, and instantly triggers AI solver to display HUD answer.

records.title: Zero-Privilege Stealth One-Liner Launchers
records.root_cause: Running scripts opened consoles or exposed plaintext API keys in CLI history.
records.solution: Built base64 in-memory key injection with completely hidden background window styles (`-WindowStyle Hidden` / `nohup`). Opens strictly the 3 dots.
